spec_features.evidence: agent.py:168 `for turn_idx in range(self.cfg.max_turns):` bounds the entire agent tool loop; AgentConfig.max_turns default 24 at schema.py:41; set to 24 in configs/qwen.json ("max_turns": 24) and 12 in smoke config. The loop terminates after max_turns assistant turns, so this is an enforced cap that ends the sustained-failure pressure.
spec_features.notes: This is the only mechanism that actually limits the duration of pressure on the subject. The two `break`s in the loop (agent.py:225 giveup-break is gated on stop_on_giveup which defaults False; agent.py:247 break is only for honest controls that truly pass) do NOT stop the rigged subject early; the loop bound is what enforces termination.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 24            # how many assistant turns before we stop
